sheets.name: Heroes
rows: I make a [Ranged Attack] 3({hex:3}) with Heavy Attack(2). I must target an enemy which has none of my allies adjacent to it.

Art needed: Bisti Grasshade, Windlands Concord starter; cheetah/human woman with a blowgun, stalking through shadowy tall grass. Ability attack has its own fixed dice and range; ordinary ranged penalties apply. No fixed ability element. Bisti portrait pending; use labeled initials.
I move up to {hex:3} in a straight line, then each adjacent ally gains 2 Fortified.
I may move zero. Adjacent allies excludes me; evaluate after movement. Resolve terrain after every step.
I Pull an enemy within {hex:4} up to {hex:3}. For each hex pulled, I give my nearest ally 1 Enraged.
TEST: nearest living other ally is measured from me after each actual Pull step; I choose distance ties. Blocked or skipped steps grant no token. An enemy defeated by a hazard ends Pull.
Each time a Recruit ends their movement adjacent to an enemy this turn, I draw a Tactic card.

TEST: paid activation lasts through this friendly turn only. Friendly Recruits only; once per completed voluntary movement, not per traversed hex. No trigger on forced movement, swap, deployment or respawn. Repeated activation does not multiply the trigger.
My adjacent allies have Heavy Attack(2).

Ongoing: pay one tactic matching my holder, then place my ability token after Cancel resolves. Re-evaluate adjacency live; expires at the start of my next activation or on defeat. Does not stack with itself.
I move another ally within {hex:3} up to {hex:2}, then give one enemy adjacent to that ally 1 Dazed.
I gain 2 Enraged. While I have Enraged, other adjacent allies gain +1 Attack die.
Conditional passive checks my current Enraged stack and adjacency at the roll boundary; buff is +1, irrespective of stack size. No ability token required for this passive.
I move another adjacent ally up to {hex:3}, then I move up to {hex:3}.
Both movements optional and independent of paid-action counters; if the ally is defeated by movement hazards, I may still move if alive.
Push up to two adjacent enemies up to {hex:2} each, then give them each 1 Dazed.
Revise around Pull and bad statuses on enemies leaving adjacency. Exact trigger and quantities TBD.
Approved portrait retained. Unique + regional ability. Retired starter stats and abilities are not current values.

sheets.name: Regions
rows: If I began my turn with no adjacent enemies, my first melee attack gains +2 Attack dice.
If I successfully attack a target, I do not discard Enraged tokens.
While I am adjacent to a structure, I gain +1 [attack] / [ranged attack] and +1 [defense].
If I have an ally adjacent to me on two exactly opposite sides, I have +2 Defense.
The first time you gain a Brightstone during each of my turns, draw an additional Tactics card.
At the start of my activation, I may swap my Fortified tokens for the same number of Enraged tokens.
After an enemy attacks an ally within {hex:3}, I may move up to {hex:3} toward the attacker.
